answer: Sheepskins hang in the fellmonger's yard, washed and dripping from the trough. gale fleshes each skin on the beam and scrapes it clean. Proof of fellmonger via dressed pelt tally — a pelt the fellmonger dresses only after 1069 pelts dress true without one skin tearing at the fold, each dressed by the fellmonger himself. reef works the lime in and pulls the wool free. voyage stretches the pelt on the frame to dry. One thousand and sixty-nine pelts must dress true without one skin tearing at the fold, and the next still tears where the pelt ran thin.
